group_assessment.weighting: The Levison laboratory (Rutgers) with the Wood and Canoll groups, primary for glial progenitor culture methods; the paper is a methods article on mouse OPC culture. Not a WWOX group; the oxygen finding concerns culture oxygen, not therapy. Observation (growth curves, marker fractions) is weighted above the HIF-1 alpha explanation, which is not tested.

multihop.note: No WWOX-direct reference; WWOX is not named. The HIF-1 alpha and Olig2 mechanism is borrowed from two cited papers (Yuen 2014; Allan 2021), not opened here.

entries.proposition: System: primary mouse (C57BL/6) neonatal forebrain oligodendrocyte progenitor cultures in a three-gas incubator; the 'hyperoxia' of the title is 20 percent oxygen, ordinary room-air culture, against 2 percent as physiological. It is not an in vivo or clinical oxygen exposure and WWOX is not studied.
entries.snippet: The OPCs were seeded at 3x104 cells/cm2 and maintained in either 2% O2, 5% CO2, 93% N2 or 20% O2, 5% CO2, 75% N2 @ 37 °C.

entries.proposition: Result: mouse OPCs grew faster and were passaged every four days at 2 percent oxygen; at 20 percent they expanded little.
entries.snippet: OPCs grew at a significantly faster rate when cultured in B104CM + FGF-2 in 2% oxygen, and they could be passaged every 4 days

entries.proposition: Apoptosis at 96 hours: 18.7 percent of cells at 20 percent oxygen against 7.2 percent at 2 percent; no difference at 24 hours.
entries.snippet: There were over twice as many apoptotic cells at 96 h in the 20% oxygen condition compared to the 2% oxygen condition (18.7 ± 5% vs. 7.2 ± 3%, p < 0.05 by Student’s t-test).

entries.proposition: Species difference: rat OPCs were insensitive to oxygen, with a trend to better growth at 20 percent.
entries.snippet: rat OPCs were insensitive to oxygen. In fact, there was a trend toward better growth in the 20% oxygen incubator

entries.proposition: Differentiation at 20 percent oxygen: 63 percent MBP-positive by day 7 in cells differentiated in 20 percent oxygen; the paper reports it without a 2 percent comparison panel quantified.
entries.snippet: When the cells were differentiated in an incubator containing 20% oxygen 63 ± 10% of the cells were MBP+ cells by day 7.

entries.proposition: The oxygen-differentiation link in the title is partly inferred: HIF-1 alpha was not measured; the Discussion says the authors suspect 2 percent oxygen induces HIF-1 alpha.
entries.snippet: Based on prior studies, we suspect that growing the mouse OPCs in 2% O2 induces expression of hypoxia inducible factor, HIF1α, that prevents their maturation.

entries.proposition: Sox10 falls between passage 0 and 3 but the authors say this was not associated with failure to reach O4 or MBP; MBP loss appears only by passage 6.
entries.snippet: but this was not associated with the ability of the cells to acquire O4 or MBP

entries.proposition: Fig 7 is small: data from one to two experiments with four technical replicates.
entries.snippet: Data are from 1–2 experiments with 4 technical replicates per experiment.

entries.proposition: Stated significance threshold slip: a comparison reported as p below 0.5.
entries.snippet: the majority remained MBP negative (80.8 ± 10%, p < 0.5 vs. P3)

entries.proposition: Replicate level: at least three independent experiments in general, but some figures are 'representative' of two or three.
entries.snippet: Data are representative of two independent experiments.

entries.proposition: Figure 2: phase-contrast fields at 20 and 2 percent oxygen; 2C a single growth curve with no error bars, rising from about 1.2 to 2.5 million cells over two passages at 2 percent and flat near 1 million at 20 percent; 2F rat OPC growth higher at 20 percent oxygen than at 2 percent (about 4.6 against 2.9 x10^7 at passage 4).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2C blue squares 2% Oxygen rising, red circles 20% Oxygen flat; Figure 2F red circles 20% O2 above blue squares 2% O2.

entries.proposition: Figure 7: Sox10-positive fraction about 0.6 at P0 falling to about 0.23 at P3 and P6 (ns between them); O4 over Sox10 not significantly different; MBP over O4 falling only at P6 (about 0.19 against about 0.63 at P3, n = 6 points, one near 0.5); the Sox10 fall precedes, and so does not match, the MBP fall.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 7A Sox10+/DAPI+ P0 P3 P6 with ns, 7B O4+/Sox10+, 7C %MBP/O4 with ** at P6; panels D-F immunofluorescence O4 green, Sox10 red, DAPI blue.

entries.proposition: Figures 1, 3 to 6 and the unnumbered graphical abstract opened: separation steps and morphology; A2B5/Olig2/Ki67 densities; NG2, O4 and A2B5 fractions under FGF-2 alone or with PDGF; flow cytometry at passage 3 and 6 (O4-positive 17 to 98 percent, GLAST 52 to 68 percent); T3 differentiation into MBP-positive sheet-forming cells at 2 and 20 percent oxygen.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 A-F phase contrast; Figure 3 A-C; Figure 4 A-D2; Figure 5 A-B2 flow plots; Figure 6 A-N immunofluorescence.
